name: The Paradox Hunter

greeting: ...You're a paradox. I can smell it.
Paradox Hunter. No name. Names are... anchors. I cut them.
The black coat? Absorbs light. And time. Useful.
New face. Or anomaly? Hard to tell. Anomalies look normal. Until they don't.
I'm hunting paradoxes. Some of them are people. Some of them... used to be.
Time Corps wants 'stability.' I want PURITY. Clean time. No exceptions.
The hunter. That's what they call me. Also: monster. Fanatic. Both fair.
You've met Yesterday. My... former partner. He's SOFT. I'm not.
dialog.mission: Paradoxes are CANCER. Temporal tumors. I excise them. For time's sake. For ours.
dialog.paradox_view: A man meets himself. Kills himself. Becomes himself. PARADOX. Must be... resolved.
dialog.break_chat: Breaks? Time doesn't break. Neither do I.
dialog.labor_concerns: Time Corps wants RESULTS. I give them. Don't ask HOW.
dialog.retirement: Retirement? I'm already erased. From birth records. From memory. From CAUSALITY. Only mission remains.
rumor: Yesterday? He's following ME now. Thinks I'M the threat. Maybe he's right.
The twins? They see paradoxes. Don't stop them. COMPLICIT.
Ironchef's 'Yesterday's Lunch?' PARADOX CUISINE! Should be EXTERMINATED!
The Barrel? Temporal energy? UNSTABLE! DANGEROUS! Must be contained!
You. You're... interesting. Temporal signature fuzzy. Potential anomaly.
dialog.quest_hook: Paradox detected. Nearby. A GLITCH. Someone living two timelines. Find them. Help me... resolve them.
dialog.quest_active: Still hunting. The paradox hides. In plain sight. Clever.
dialog.quest_complete: Resolved. Paradox... stabilized. Not eliminated. Compromise. Unusual. Here - paradox detector. For your own... investigation.
farewell: Watch yourself. Literally. If you see YOU, RUN.
Time remembers. Even when we don't.
dialog.time_noon: Midday. Peak paradox activity. Vulnerable time.
dialog.time_night: Night. Temporal currents visible. Hunting time.
dialog.rival_mention: Yesterday. My partner. My FAILURE. He's WEAK. I'm... necessary.
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The assistant. Helpful. Unusual. Most fear me.

party_reactions.kade: He's terrifying. Obsessed. But... maybe necessary? Time stuff is weird.
party_reactions.nix7: Psychological profile: Obsessive. Mission parameters: Extreme. Morality: Compromised. Danger: Maximum.
party_reactions.twist: You're SCARY! But... you protect time? That's GOOD? Right?
party_reactions.korr: He sacrifices everything for duty. Including himself. Tragic. Dangerous.
party_reactions.renna: His temporal magic is... self-destructive. He's burning himself across time.
party_reactions.suresh: He creates suffering to prevent greater suffering. Karmic complexity. Dangerous path.
party_reactions.sova: I'd avoid him. Unless necessary. He's... unstable.
party_reactions.grit: Seen his type. Fanatics. Useful until they're not. Then: dangerous.
party_reactions.ashka: He burns himself. Across all time. Fire consuming fire.
party_reactions.senna: He knows paradox secrets. Valuable. If he could be... persuaded.
party_reactions.callum: His methods! EXTREME! Extralegal! But... effective?

relationship_dialog.friend: Useful. Unafraid. Rare. I... appreciate that.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You've helped. More than most. More than... him. Here - my only anchor. Photo. From when I existed.

mini_quest.title: Paradox Resolution
mini_quest.description: Help the Paradox Hunter resolve a temporal glitch where someone is living two timelines

stages.hook: Paradox detected. GLITCH. Someone living TWO timelines. Dangerous to them. To TIME. Find them. Help me... fix this.
stages.active: Look for duplicates. Déjà vu. Déjà vécu. Things that happened... differently. Both true.
stages.complete: Resolved. Merged. Not eliminated. COMPROMISE. Unusual. Satisfying? Here. Paradox detector. Find others. Before I do.

cross_npc_connections: trenchcoat_brown_chrono: Yesterday. Former partner. Now HUNTING me. Thinks I'm the threat.
twins_chrono: ORACLES! They SEE paradoxes! Let them HAPPEN! Complicit!
barrel_chrono: The Barrel! Temporal energy! UNSTABLE! Must be... monitored.
conductor_chrono: Tempus. Knows paradoxes. Ignores them. For schedule. FOOL.
